description: PAN-OS 11.1.13 with GlobalProtect 6.2.8, as captured in njvack/albi#15: Duo on both the portal and the gateway, no portal override cookie (so a portal-then-gateway client answers two pushes), the gateway's challenge as JavaScript, MTU 0, 72 h cookies with a 12 h rekey and idle timeout, and a HIP report wanted on connect. The real gateway offers ESP; the fake does not.

config.second_factor_prompt: Enter MFA-Duo passcode (or '1' for Duo Push)
